title: The Sunbird
description:
Name: [Umvuthi](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/umvuthi.png:150:150)
Known Locations: Savannas
Estimated Size: Large
Behavior: Remains stationary even when attacked and passive to others wearing [Umvuthana Masks](image:mowziesmobs:textures/item/umvuthana_mask_bliss_icon.png:50:50). Relies on its [followers](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/umvuthana.png:150:150) and ranged beams of light. When very hurt, uses its followers energy to form a shield and recover from its wounds.
Danger Level: §4§lHard
